Easy Beef and Broccoli
Yield: 5 servings

INGREDIENTS
For the beef:
- 1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
- 2 Tbsp cornstarch
- 1 Tbsp avocado oil, divided
For the sauce:
- ⅓ cup low sodium soy sauce
- 2 tbsp honey
- 3 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 tsp sesame oil
- 1/2 cup water
To serve:
- 4 cups broccoli florets
- 2 cups cooked jasmine rice

INSTRUCTIONS
Toss the sliced flank steak with the cornstarch.
Whisk together the soy sauce, honey, garlic, sesame oil and water.
Heat half the avocado oil in a large pan over high heat and sear the beef in two batches until browned. Remove.
Add the remaining avocado oil and the broccoli florets; cook 3-4 minutes.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce and simmer until thickened. Serve over the jasmine rice.
